metadata.followup_qualification: The acquisition labels called this a natural-failure intent, but Build 53 was already canceled and had UNKNOWN status. No natural nonzero-exit or uncancel-success claim follows. Its actual entities remain under accurate observation IDs.

limits: Same administrator, actual owned Linux Agent and a controlled definition. Plain log/problem writes, displayed number/status, finish observation only.
